cases.explanation: User-declared process label: AI-generated portrait base followed by a face swap. The generation log is incomplete and is not signed provenance; the workshop did not independently replay either step. The displayed file is the documented 1024×1024 metadata-stripped JPEG derivative. On these exact bytes, UniversalFakeDetect returns 0.2146, Community Forensics 0.0071, SPAI 0.000039, AIDE 0.0771, GenD 0.8971, and FatFormer 0.000021. Five broad whole-image models lean toward their non-synthetic class while the narrower face-manipulation model GenD leans strongly manipulated. This contrast is useful evidence of task scope and detector limitations, not six votes, probabilities, or proof. cases.prompt: Save your first judgement at 100%, then inspect the subject boundary, heart-shaped highlights, colour channels and edge/detail view using the same settings. Reveal the five exact-file classifier outputs last. Could the unusual appearance arise during capture, editing, or generation?
cases.explanation: User-declared process label: authentic camera photograph with heart-shaped highlights produced optically using a shaped aperture cut-out. The preserved source contains Fujifilm camera metadata, but that is not signed capture provenance and does not prove semantic truth. The displayed file is an orientation-normalized 2730×4096 metadata-stripped JPEG derivative. On these exact bytes, UniversalFakeDetect returns 0.9547, Community Forensics 0.001579, SPAI 1.285e-8, AIDE 0.0529, and FatFormer 0.000108. GenD is N/A because no face was detected; no zero was substituted. UniversalFakeDetect leans strongly synthetic while the other four whole-image scores remain low. The preserved 1920-pixel derivative scored 0.0202 with the same UniversalFakeDetect model, so this disagreement also demonstrates sensitivity to crop scale and preprocessing; neither output is a probability or proof. The creator authorized this derivative for public workshop distribution on 29 September 2026; that authorization is not signed provenance and was not independently verified.
